card.name: Deaths and victims in disaster or crime accounts
card.fires_on: Words and numbers in news-style accounts of killings and disasters, just before the text names who died or was harmed. Seen on "murder of", "killing" and the digits of death tolls.

modes.label: Murder or kidnapping
modes.description: Linking words after murder or in a description of an abducted person, before the victim is named or the crime is described.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about victims, lives lost and people who died, such as victims, alive and tragedy.
card.plain: It fires in reports of killings and disasters, where the text is about to say who died or how many.
